title: Herbal Velvety Polish Kabanos Sausages One-Pot
description: Tender kabanos sausages in a rich and creamy sauce, infused with fragrant herbs and spices, all cooked in one pot. A hearty and comforting dish perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large scallop-shell vessel over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced carrots and cook for 5 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the kabanos sausages and cook for 2-3 minutes, until browned on all sides.
Add the vegetable broth, heavy cream, parsley, thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, until the sausages are cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the sausages and sauce hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Be careful when serving as the vessel may be hot.
Use a spatula to carefully remove the sausages and sauce from the vessel and serve on a plate.
Make sure to clean the vessel thoroughly after use to prevent any bacterial growth.
